system.title: System Information
system.subtitle: Complete overview of all data sources, connections, and architecture
system.archMonolith: Single Express process serves the built React SPA (static files from /dist) and all API endpoints. One container, one process, one port.
system.archAuth: JWT access tokens are issued and RS256-signed by digita-auth, the suite's standalone identity provider. digita-post is purely a JWT consumer — it verifies tokens offline against digita-auth's JWKS endpoint (AUTH_JWKS_URL); there is no shared secret.
system.whoPopulatesDesc: After every sendEmail() call, a fire-and-forget insertOne() writes the email log entry to this collection. The DB write never blocks email delivery.
system.dataSourceDnsSmtp: Data Source: DNS Lookups + SMTP Connection
system.authFlow: Login happens on the digita-auth IdP: unauthenticated users are redirected to the IdP's own login page, which returns them here after sign-in. The session lives in httpOnly cookies scoped to the shared parent zone, so the SPA calls the IdP's /api/v1/auth/* endpoints (refresh, 2FA, recovery, sessions) cross-origin at the IdP URL — digita-post serves no auth endpoints of its own and verifies the session JWT offline via JWKS on every API call.
system.noUserDb: No user database in digita-post — it is purely a JWT consumer. All user data (email, name, role, customer_no) comes from the JWT payload.
system.resendTrigger: Admin clicks 'Resend' on a failed email in the Email Logs page and optionally edits to, cc, subject.
